item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena hangs a small stone from a thread in her veranda to make a simple pendulum for her science project. She pulls the stone aside and lets it swing freely.
To time her pendulum correctly, she must count one complete oscillation. Which of these motions of the stone is one complete oscillation?

options.A: The stone moves from the mean position to one extreme position.
options.B: The stone moves from one extreme position back to the mean position.
options.C: The stone moves from the mean position to the other extreme position and stops there.
options.D: The stone starts at the mean position, moves to one extreme position, then to the other extreme position, and returns to the mean position.
